name: Charles Goerens - § 66/1
title: REPORT on financing for development – ahead of the Fourth International Conference on Financing for Development in Seville
part_text: Text as a whole without the words: ‘long-term, sustainable funding for United Nations Relief and Works Agency for Palestine Refugees in the Near East (UNRWA), guaranteeing’
part_context: Calls on the EU and the Member States to ensure that ODA includes <del>long-term, sustainable funding for United Nations Relief and Works Agency for Palestine Refugees in the Near East (UNRWA), guaranteeing</del> access to essential services for Palestinian refugees and preventing further humanitarian crises;
